title: Add DailyListViewModel and LogDoseOutcome
description: AndroidViewModel backing the daily list / add-dose flow: exposes active profiles and medications as StateFlow, per-profile dose-history Flow accessors, and the safety-critical logDose() function that evaluates dose timing via DoseTimingCalculator before inserting a DoseLog and scheduling its reminder, returning a NeedsConfirmation outcome instead of inserting when the dose is too soon and the caller hasn't acknowledged the warning yet.
acceptance_criteria: sealed class LogDoseOutcome with object Logged and data class NeedsConfirmation(val minutesRemaining: Long)

class DailyListViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) constructs AppDatabase.getDatabase(application) and a ProfileRepository/MedicationRepository/DoseLogRepository from its DAOs in the class body, no DI framework

val activeProfiles: StateFlow<List<Profile>> and val activeMedications: StateFlow<List<Medication>> each converted from the repository's Flow via .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), emptyList())
fun observeRecentDoses(profileId: Int): Flow<List<DoseLog>> and fun observeMostRecentDose(profileId: Int, medicationId: Int): Flow<DoseLog?> delegate straight to the repository

fun logDose(profileId: Int, medicationId: Int, givenAtEpochMillis: Long, doseAmount: String, acknowledgeWarning: Boolean, onResult: (LogDoseOutcome) -> Unit) launches a viewModelScope coroutine that: looks up the medication, gets the most recent dose snapshot for that profile+medication, calls DoseTimingCalculator.evaluateTiming, and if the result is TooSoon and acknowledgeWarning is false calls onResult(NeedsConfirmation(minutesRemaining)) and returns without inserting anything

Otherwise logDose computes nextEligible via DoseTimingCalculator.computeNextEligible, inserts a DoseLog (setting wasOverrideWarningAcknowledged to true only if the timing result was TooSoon), schedules the reminder via ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule using the inserted row id (as Int) when both nextEligible and medication are non-null, and finally calls onResult(Logged)
Valid Kotlin under package com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.ui referencing the data and notifications packages
exact_code:
package com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.ui

import android.app.Application
import androidx.lifecycle.AndroidViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data.AppDatabase
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data.DoseLog
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data.DoseLogRepository
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data.DoseTimingCalculator
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data.DoseTimingResult
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data.Medication
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data.MedicationRepository
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data.Profile
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data.ProfileRepository
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.notifications.ExactAlarmScheduler
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

sealed class LogDoseOutcome {
    object Logged : LogDoseOutcome()
    data class NeedsConfirmation(val minutesRemaining: Long) : LogDoseOutcome()
}

class DailyListViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
    private val db = AppDatabase.getDatabase(application)
    private val profileRepository = ProfileRepository(db.profileDao())
    private val medicationRepository = MedicationRepository(db.medicationDao())
    private val doseLogRepository = DoseLogRepository(db.doseLogDao())

    val activeProfiles: StateFlow<List<Profile>> = profileRepository.activeProfiles
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), emptyList())

    val activeMedications: StateFlow<List<Medication>> = medicationRepository.activeMedications
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), emptyList())

    fun observeRecentDoses(profileId: Int): Flow<List<DoseLog>> =
        doseLogRepository.observeRecentForProfile(profileId)

    fun observeMostRecentDose(profileId: Int, medicationId: Int): Flow<DoseLog?> =
        doseLogRepository.observeMostRecentDose(profileId, medicationId)

    fun logDose(
        profileId: Int,
        medicationId: Int,
        givenAtEpochMillis: Long,
        doseAmount: String,
        acknowledgeWarning: Boolean,
        onResult: (LogDoseOutcome) -> Unit,
    ) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val medication = medicationRepository.getById(medicationId)
            val mostRecentDose = doseLogRepository.getMostRecentDoseSnapshot(profileId, medicationId)
            val timing = DoseTimingCalculator.evaluateTiming(
                givenAtEpochMillis,
                mostRecentDose,
                medication?.minIntervalMinutes,
            )
            if (timing is DoseTimingResult.TooSoon && !acknowledgeWarning) {
                onResult(LogDoseOutcome.NeedsConfirmation(timing.minutesRemaining))
                return@launch
            }
            val nextEligible = DoseTimingCalculator.computeNextEligible(
                givenAtEpochMillis,
                medication?.minIntervalMinutes,
            )
            val doseLogId = doseLogRepository.insert(
                DoseLog(
                    profileId = profileId,
                    medicationId = medicationId,
                    givenAtEpochMillis = givenAtEpochMillis,
                    doseAmount = doseAmount,
                    nextEligibleAtEpochMillis = nextEligible,
                    wasOverrideWarningAcknowledged = timing is DoseTimingResult.TooSoon,
                ),
            )
            if (nextEligible != null && medication != null) {
                ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule(
                    getApplication<Application>(),
                    doseLogId.toInt(),
                    nextEligible,
                    "Dose window open",
                    "${medication.name} is now eligible for another dose",
                )
            }
            onResult(LogDoseOutcome.Logged)
        }
    }
}
